$comment: Format A (full schema, Plan P2.6). JSON Schema for output_config.format. "x-cjp-enum" is replaced by the enum from taxonomy/labels.yaml when the schema is rendered (cjp/triage/schema.py) and never reaches the API. The descriptions are listed in the system prompt and left out of the schema sent. Property order is generation order: the decision fields come first, in the same order as Format B, so A and B differ only in what follows them.

technique_label.description: Exactly one value from the technique label list: a label, none, other or uncertain.

candidate_labels.description: Only when technique_label is uncertain: every label (two or more) that the evidence still fits. Otherwise an empty list.

disposition.description: What should happen to this alert.

confidence.description: How strongly the evidence in this alert supports technique_label and disposition.

recommended_action.description: 1-2 sentences: the specific next step for the analyst, which fits the disposition.

event_type.description: 5 words max: a readable name for what happened.

severity.description: Potential impact if the activity is what it appears to be.

reasoning.description: 2 sentences max: why, citing the evidence that decided it, or the missing evidence that would.

evidence.description: Comma-separated key fields from the alert that support the decision (e.g. method, path, status, rule, body excerpt).

cognitive_notes.description: 1 sentence: context the analyst needs that is not in the alert.
